title: Provider evidence and evaluation binding require exact pair continuity before holdout opening
decision: Use invest/opening.py as the offline opening gate for a provider-evidence/binding pair.
Revalidate both objects and require evidence/license/raw/normalized/code identities to match.
Require all seven market-data boundary states and supporting-evidence hashes to match exactly.
Opening readiness is true only when both provider-side and binding-side readiness are true.
rationale: D021 linked copied provenance fields but did not compare the binding against the complete referenced provider evidence record.
